reviewList.author: Toan P

reviewList.text:
This spa is in a super convenient location near Nguyen Van Thoai beach road, very easy to walk to when traveling in Da Nang. The shop itself is beautiful and eye-catching, creating a very relaxing atmosphere from the moment you walk in.

The staff were all incredibly warm, attentive, and professional. The massage was absolutely amazing — so relaxing and comfortable that I felt completely refreshed afterward. The receptionists were also very friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better.

At the end of the massage, they even served delicious creamy flan cake and bananas, such a sweet and thoughtful touch 🥹

Highly recommend this spa to anyone visiting Da Nang. Definitely a place worth experiencing!
reviewList.author: CHI DINH NHAT

reviewList.text: From the time Panda pick me up from my hotel, to the well appointed receptionist area and the serenely peaceful massage rooms, Panda Spa knows how to pamper a client. The four hands massage was the best massage I have ever received. They have highly professional staff. My massage also included hot stones and oil. Well worth the money. My only regret is that I do not have more time to spend in DaNang for another massage.
reviewList.author: Christi Coomes

places.name: Julius Spa & Massage
places.address: B4-14, An Thượng 38, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text: 10 out of 10 experience! Welcome tea and mango, then the massage itself was amazing. Feel like I was reborn. :-) then after the massage one gets treated with a tea and some local coconut cracker as well as I was given  some coconut gift as well. A very rare hidden gem. Atmosphere and staff are very friendly and very welcoming. Will definitely come back. Thank you 🙏🏼
reviewList.author: Roland Danyi

reviewList.text: Been here a couple of times during my stay and always had a great experience. The massage and hair wash were both amazing, and the staff are so welcoming and friendly. I also love the little touches — mango and pandan tea when you arrive, then coconut biscuits and tea before you leave. Such a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere 😌
reviewList.author: Sara L

reviewList.text: My husband and I went here together. I did the 60 min hot stone massage + 30 min shampoo and he did the thai massage. The massages were very good with the right amount of pressure and friendly staff that checked in to make sure we were enjoying it throughout. This was my first shampoo experience, so I did not know what to expect. It was very enjoyable but a new hair brush that was not previously used would have been preferred. The staff asked me to leave this review with a picture before leaving, which I did not appreciate, although overall still a good experience.
reviewList.author: Kelsea Mitropoulos

reviewList.text: An amazing time was had here at Julius Spa & Massage (1). Clean and probably the best service you’ll find around for this price point.
reviewList.author: Camden Smith

reviewList.text: Super relaxing massage. The staffs are kind and the place is clean. We came and they give us mango and tea. After the massage they give us tea and snacks.
reviewList.author: Raul Martirez Jr.

reviewList.text: loved my aroma body massage! Really like that i can choose which specific areas to focus on, also on which ones I want to be avoided. everything was really relaxing and great
reviewList.author: Klodia Gabaya

reviewList.text: I saw the Crayon Shin-chan figure at the entrance, and suddenly felt sympathy and familiarity, and received the full course that can be received at the barber shop. I really liked it. And the kindness. I recommend it..
reviewList.author: B.S. David Kim

reviewList.text: I think I was approached by the Korean owner lady when I walk in for nail inquiry.  Nice simply place.  Location is facing the river.  Staffs are super friendly.  Price is reasonable too.
reviewList.author: Amanda O

reviewList.text: Massage was excellent and location was very convenient. The view spa located near Han Market and the River, nice place to get relaxed after market shopping. They also provide pick up and sanding service.
reviewList.author: R Lee

reviewList.text: Clean and central, reasonable and very good massage! We visited on a cruise and stopped to be pampered! They added a 10% tip which was very fair. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Barbara Kent

reviewList.text: Professional service with friendly staffs, highly recommend you guys to come at this hair salon.
reviewList.author: Huynh Jasmine

reviewList.text: Good service, friendly staff
reviewList.author: Như ý Hoàng

places.name: Maha Spa - Massage, Facial, Shampoo
places.address: 26 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text:
Must-try experience when visiting Da Nang!

I had an incredible time at Maha Spa. The space is absolutely stunning - peaceful, beautifully decorated, and relaxing from the moment you walk through the door. The staff is so warm, welcoming, and enthusiastic!
What I appreciated most was how attentive my therapist was during the massage - they proactively checked in on the pressure throughout the entire session to make sure everything felt just right. Truly a top-notch experience.
Highly recommended!👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
reviewList.author: Mai Thị Thùy Dung

reviewList.text:
I visited Maha Spa and overall, it was an okay experience—but not one I’d recommend if you’re truly looking for a relaxing, high-quality massage.
The facilities were one of the biggest downsides. There wasn’t proper indoor shoe storage, and the men’s and women’s changing areas were more like small stalls with partially working lockers. From what my partner experienced, the women’s lockers didn’t even have keys, which made it impossible to securely store belongings. The staff didn’t seem too concerned when this was brought up, which was disappointing.
We booked a 90-minute session that included a herbal hot compress, hot stone treatment, and foot massage. The foot bath portion was decent—they cleaned and lightly massaged our feet well. My massage itself was good, with strong and consistent pressure from the therapist. However, my partner had a much less pleasant experience and felt uncomfortable, especially when the therapist described her as being “difficult,” which was frustrating since we were just trying to relax.
The massage setup also lacked privacy. The beds were all in one large room, separated only by sheer curtains. You could hear therapists whispering and talking to each other or other clients, which really took away from the overall relaxation.
They did serve jasmine tea at the beginning and end, along with a mango pudding dessert. Unfortunately, the pudding tasted sour, so we didn’t eat it.
On a positive note, there was a very cute and friendly cat near the entrance, which was a nice touch.
Overall, while parts of the massage were decent, the lack of proper facilities, privacy, and attentiveness from staff made it hard to fully enjoy the experience. I wouldn’t recommend this place if you’re looking for a truly relaxing spa visit.
reviewList.author: Calvin Duong (The Goods)

reviewList.text: Excellent experience at Maha Spa. Very professional staff, extremely clean and relaxing environment, and honestly one of the best massages I’ve ever had. From the moment we arrived, everything felt polished, welcoming, and well-managed. The therapists were skilled, attentive, and made the entire experience incredibly relaxing. Highly recommend Maha Spa if you’re in Da Nang and looking for a high-quality massage experience.
reviewList.author: James Gibson

reviewList.text:
Clean, comfortable environment. Traded a google review for an extra 30 minutes of massage time. I’m unable to give accurate review of massage because they wanted the review prior to  going in for the treatment.

Update: 30 minutes into the treatment the electricity went out. We were offered a full refund. When we went for the refund they changed it to a partial refund. Ms. Hai Nhi kindly reached out to management at our request, and a full refund was eventually given.
reviewList.author: Melanie Martin

reviewList.text: Such a lovely place to relax after walking around the city all day. The staff were friendly, the therapist was very skilled, and I almost fell asleep during the massage. Would definitely come back!
reviewList.author: Nhat ny Pham

places.name: Clover Spa - Best Spa Massage Da Nang 다낭 마사지

reviewList.text:
The ambiance is alright. They provide iced tea before the massage, and afterwards, they serve iced tea, a bowl of porridge, coconut crackers & a cold towel. But even with 20% off, the price still isn't competitive, the massage technique has a lot of room for improvement, though I get that it depends heavily on the therapist. The poor therapist was nodding off multiple times during my session, I didn't want to be too harsh on her, considering it was quite late n she had probably been working a very long shift.
It's an okay option if u’r already in the area n desperate for a massage, but definitely not worth going out of your way for.
reviewList.author: Gerald

reviewList.text:
We had an incredible experience here! After a grueling hike up Marble Mountain, my wife and I both opted for the leg and foot massage, and it was exactly what we needed. The facility was spotless, and the staff were exceptionally polite and welcoming.
Communication was a breeze—even though my Vietnamese is limited, they provided a clear English menu that made selecting services easy. The pricing is very reasonable for the quality of care you receive. To top it off, once the massage was over, they served us refreshing tea, delicious rice porridge, and coconut crackers. We enjoyed it so much that we came back a second time for a full body massage before flying back to the States. It was the perfect ending to our vacation!
reviewList.author: Trung Huynh

reviewList.text:
Came here with the 4 of us and had a great time. I got the foot massage with hot stones. The therapist would press her hands onto the hot stones and massage my legs and feet with her warm hands. It felt incredibly soothing and the pressure points were just right. My legs and feet were exhausted going in but I walked out feeling totally refreshed.

The place was clean, the staff were friendly, and the congee afterwards was delicious.
reviewList.author: Liza Wong

reviewList.text:
Walked in, appointment was available immediately. My massage was professional, and according to the fill-out form i got in advance. Got Drinks before and after, and a tasty porridge and refreshment towels after the massage, i booked the shiatsu for 90min.

Very good experience, can recommend. Mina Lyn is very welcoming and gives the Place a wonderful vibe.
reviewList.author: Christoph Ernst

reviewList.text: Wow, one of the best massages I have received in my life. Seriously, my masseuse got out every single crink. I feel so light, words do no justice. And the customer service is top notch, they serve you tea in the beginning and then more tea at the end with porridge and coconut crackers. I can't wait to come back! And thank you Mina for helping me check out at the end, very smooth and seamless.
reviewList.author: Shana Webb

reviewList.text:
Our experience at Oani Spa was absolutely outstanding. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with genuine warmth and exceptional hospitality.
The spa is beautifully designed, spotless, and provides a peaceful atmosphere that immediately helps you relax. The therapists were highly professional, skilled, and attentive to every detail, ensuring we were comfortable throughout the entire treatment.
The massage and foot treatment exceeded our expectations, leaving us feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated. The level of service and care was truly first-class.
We highly recommend Oani Spa to anyone visiting Da Nang who is looking for a luxurious and relaxing spa experience. We will definitely be back on our next trip!
reviewList.author: Keyvan Keshtkar

reviewList.text: My husband and I got some pampering massages here.  The staff were nice and our technicians both had firm touches which was what we wanted. Place is relaxing and all is good except that I have to remind the technicians to keep the blankets on our backs if they are working on our legs.  Especially since we were right below the AC blowing at us at full blast.  So overall we both had a relaxing massage except for the cold air and my husband and I both ended up catching a cold.
reviewList.author: Dr. Mia Hanh Nguyen

reviewList.text:
My wife Nhung and I had an amazing experience at Oani Spa in Da Nang! We booked the 70-minute full-body massage along with the steam room and sauna, and everything was outstanding from start to finish.

The spa was spotless, peaceful, and beautifully designed, creating the perfect atmosphere to relax. The massage therapists were professional, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout the entire session. The massage was the perfect balance of relaxing and therapeutic, helping relieve all of our muscle tension after traveling.

The steam room and sauna were a fantastic addition and left us feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated. The staff was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and provided excellent customer service.

If you’re looking for one of the best massage and spa experiences in Da Nang, we highly recommend Oani Spa. We’ll definitely be coming back the next time we’re in Vietnam!
reviewList.author: bryan abernathy

reviewList.text:
Walked in without an appointment and got a foot massage for 45mins.

Really lovely place and masseuse Trinh was very good. I fell asleep unknowingly- that was how relaxing it was. Wanted to get a pedicure but I had to be somewhere else so had to cut it short.

Massage was firm but still very relaxing. Rooms were clean and spacious with dim lighting. There was a fish tank too which was probably useful in unwinding and relaxing if you didn’t want to keep your eyes closed.

They also have an option for just a back massage which is great for me as I can’t stay still for a your!!!
reviewList.author: Sue Sieper

reviewList.text: I walked in without an appointment around 4pm on a Wednesday. It was busy in the lobby so I expected to be turned away without an appointment, but to my surprise I was sat almost immediately. I have a full-body sunburn so I was only in for a 30 minute scalp scrub. Nu, I hope I am spelling that right, did a fantastic job. Every movement felt intentional and she was sure to ask if pressure/water temp etc. is okay. Nu was very diligent about getting out all of the conditioner off my hair. She also gave me some gentle stretches which was nice since I wasn’t able to have any massage services. I came in with low expectations due to experiencing other spas that I did not like too much, so this was a lovely experience. I would genuinely recommend this place. The atmosphere is nice, the only downside would be that it is one big room for the foot massages, scalp scrubs, and blow drys so it’s not totally “serene” but the service you are getting beats that. It’s also very clean and the hair products feel nice. I hope to return again one day
reviewList.author: Alex Bauernfeind

reviewList.text: I’m a fan of Sen Tai Thu in Hanoi, so when they opened a branch in Da Nang I visited a few times and have been very satisfied each time. The quality has stayed at the same level as in Hanoi, and even the food tastes exactly like it does at the original location there. I’ll definitely keep coming back regularly.
reviewList.author: Khue Ho

reviewList.text:
Sen Tài Thu Đà Nẵng offers a truly rejuvenating massage experience, combining professional service with genuine care. From the moment you arrive, the staff greets you with kindness and friendliness, making you feel comfortable and at ease. Their attentiveness throughout the session ensures that you are well taken care of, whether it’s adjusting pressure, offering guidance, or simply creating a calm and welcoming atmosphere.

The massage itself is deeply relaxing, melting away tension and leaving both body and mind refreshed. What sets this place apart, however, is the thoughtful touch of serving food after the massage. The dishes are tasty and hearty—nourishing in a way that perfectly complements the wellness experience. It feels less like a spa visit and more like a holistic retreat where relaxation and nourishment go hand in hand.

If you are in Đà Nẵng and looking for a massage that combines skilled techniques, genuine hospitality, and a hearty meal, Sen Tài Thu is a wonderful choice.
reviewList.author: Min Min

reviewList.text: Things weren't perfectly professional, but I'll still give it 5 stars so you can improve.
reviewList.author: Julia NG

reviewList.text:
As someone who’s pretty picky and a huge fan of therapeutic massage, I have to say this place was worth the experience. The therapists here are highly skilled, well-trained, and you can really tell they know what they’re doing—not just going through the motions.

What I liked most is that the experience feels complete. Besides the massage itself, the package also included body scrubbing, exfoliation, herbal soaking, and cupping therapy, which made it feel more like recovery than just relaxation.

It’s definitely not cheap, but personally I think it’s worth the price for what you get. Compared to massage experiences around Vietnam, I still think Da Nang isn’t quite at the level of Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi in terms of technique and variety, but it’s still pretty solid compared to many other places.

If you’re a hardcore massage fan and enjoy massages that leave you feeling like your body got a full reset, this place is worth trying 👍
reviewList.author: Tiffany Ly

reviewList.text: This massage is a scam. The massage was average. The price is higher than the neighbourhood massage. We bought a 60 minute massage and ended up with only 45 minutes massage as they included the shower time, changing time and stream time all together for one hour. This store is not honest.
reviewList.author: Ellen Chau

places.name: Beauty Salon LỘC V1 - Hair Salon Da Nang

reviewList.text:
Great experience from start to finish! I was warmly welcomed and even offered a drink when I arrived, which was a nice touch.
A big thank you to NGUYỄN ĐỨC HƯNG for the excellent service. He listened carefully to what I wanted and delivered exactly the look I was hoping for. Professional, skilled, and friendly throughout the appointment.
I'm very happy with the result and would highly recommend both the salon and NGUYỄN ĐỨC HƯNG. I'll definitely be back!
reviewList.author: Karah Waasdorp

reviewList.text:
Please don’t come here.

I chose Salon Loc after doing quite a bit of research because they had strong reviews on both Google and Reddit. I went in wanting a C-curl and volume perm to fix two main issues: flatness and frizz. I even prepared a full Pinterest board of reference photos and used ChatGPT to translate exactly what I wanted and what my concerns were.

The service was not cheap — I paid around USD 120. On top of that, they pushed me to add a keratin treatment. I later learned that combining a keratin treatment with a fresh perm is generally not recommended, which already made me question the salon’s understanding of hair health and treatment compatibility.

The experience itself also felt disorganized. The manager who initially consulted me disappeared midway through the appointment and handed me over to someone else without much explanation. The handling throughout was quite rough, and I went through around five separate washes. They also mentioned a haircut and massage as part of the service — the massage was relaxing enough, but it was just a standard shoulder massage and not really anything notable.

What concerned me most was the actual perming process. I kept trying to trust the process, but several things felt off, including them using a hair straightener on my hair while product was still applied.

Unfortunately, the final result speaks for itself. The “volume perm” sections are visibly sticking out in awkward bends, while the C-curl I originally wanted is basically nonexistent. The stylist recommended going for a softer wave instead, but the end result just looks like poorly rebonded hair with random bends underneath. My hair also feels significantly more damaged now, especially near the roots, and salons back home have already told me the damage makes it difficult to safely fix or salvage.
reviewList.author: Kim

reviewList.text:
Honestly?

The best experience of hair styling I’ve ever had so far! The service is top notch, the hair spa — amazing, the massage even more!

I loved every minute✨
I got my hair done by hair stylist Hung, and he understood what I wanted from a simple picture. He was very friendly and kind, and I saw that he knew what he was doing. A true expert in hair styling and hair care✨😍

I would heartily recommend stylist Hung and Loc salon to anyone wondering if they should come here. You definitely should and NEED to come and experience this
reviewList.author: Абигель Джумабек

reviewList.text: Very good and professional team. Got a keratin treatment and haircut. It came with head and neck massage. The haircut was so good exactly the way I described and better even though they don’t speak English. He even recommended something that doesn’t need a lot of maintenance. Really happy with everything. Thank you!
reviewList.author: Melanie S

reviewList.text: Been here three times and the service is always spot on. The stylists take their time and will happily trim it more if it’s not to your liking. Special thanks to Phuong—he’s done my layered cut twice now. Super talented, attentive, and highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Yi Zhen

reviewList.text:
Everything went very well. I used Google Translate and some photos to explain exactly what I wanted. I got a hair smoothing treatment, a color, and a haircut.

Everything was done perfectly. They took great care of me and made sure everything was exactly right. I have very curly hair naturally, and the smoothing treatment is incredible.

A special thanks to the young man who took care of me.

I will definitely come back, and I highly recommend this salon. The prices are affordable, the staff is super friendly, and the quality of the service is excellent.
reviewList.author: Amr

reviewList.text: Very good experience here! I asked for them to match my natural hair colour/eyebrow colour and they did it perfectly! I paid extra for the olaplaex treatment as my hair was incredible dry. The head wash was lovely and long! Overall paid 2.5 million for the dye, cut and treatment. 1.5 million without the treatment - to me that’s a very good deal for the quality I got. They also gave me lots of water and a great ice coffee too 👍🏼
reviewList.author: Emily Cox

reviewList.text: Before my hair appointment, my hair was all over the place, there were orange and yellow tones, blonde streaks, and a bit of everything. I went to Zero Hair Salon, and I’m really glad I did. I wanted a dark root, light ends, and a cool-toned result, and that’s exactly what I got. I definitely recommend it, and the customer service was really great too!🩷🩷🫶🏼
reviewList.author: Aleksandra Pohjanheimo

reviewList.text:
First time trying this salon in Da Nang and it was a great experience. Even though I only came in for root colouring and a haircut, the service was fast, professional, and reliable. The team was very welcoming and even offered me a local Vietnamese coffee, which was a really nice touch.

I’m very satisfied with the result and the haircut. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a good salon with reasonable price in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Melissa Lok

reviewList.text:
Overall, I’m quite disappointed with my experience.

If you’re looking for blonde services (bleaching/toning), I’d recommend going elsewhere. My roots came out quite yellow at first, and even after correction, the blonde doesn’t look properly finished — it feels like it was only bleached, without a proper toner or the cool tones I asked for.

I also asked for a blunt bob, but the cut lacks precision and sharpness, so I’ll need to have it fixed elsewhere.

For simple services, this salon may be fine, but for more technical work like blonding or precise cuts, the results didn’t meet expectations.
reviewList.author: Marie

reviewList.text:
I had such a wonderful experience at Rosie Spa in Da Nang. I booked one of their combo packages and it was absolutely worth it. The whole experience was very relaxing from beginning to end. The spa is clean, peaceful, and beautifully designed, which makes it the perfect place to unwind after a long day of traveling.
The staff were incredibly friendly, gentle, and professional. They always made sure I was comfortable and explained the treatments clearly. The massage helped release a lot of tension in my body, and the facial was amazing. They use natural ingredients which left my skin feeling fresh, calm, and glowing afterwards.
What I really appreciated was the attention to detail and the warm, welcoming atmosphere. You can really tell that they care about their customers' experience.
If you are visiting Da Nang and looking for a quality spa with great service and relaxing treatments, I highly recommend Rosie Spa. I will definitely come back again on my next trip!
reviewList.author: Thi Nguyễn

reviewList.text: Wonderful head and facial spa experience! My skin felt so clean, hydrated, and glowing afterward. The staff were gentle, professional, and made me feel completely relaxed. The head, neck, and shoulder massage was incredibly soothing and expertly done. I also loved the thoughtful touch of serving tea, fresh fruit, and snacks before and after the treatment. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Cassie Palomar

reviewList.text: Had a relaxing massage at Rosie Wellness Spa. Me and my husband had an aroma therapy full body massage at this spa during our trip to Danang. Incredible experience, clean rooms, polite and friendly staff, lovely interior, affordable prices, we paid 650k vnd each for a 90min session. They also serve tea & fruits before and after spa session. Highly recommended
reviewList.author: M B

reviewList.text: My wife and I really wanted to have full body massages during our trip to Da Nang. We were walking and found Rosie Wellness Spa. We did not have a reservation but they were able to take us for two 60 minute aroma full body massages. We both selected lemongrass and strong strength. The two massage technicians were astounding. So thoughtful and so strong. We felt so good afterwards we made reservations for 90 minute aroma massages for the very next day. We cannot recommend this spa highly enough.
reviewList.author: Shaun Barrett

reviewList.text: The best massage place in all of danang. Ended up going three times and tried all the types of treatments and they were all amazing! Pressure was excellent (I like it with a lot of pressure). 10/10 would recommend and would go back.
reviewList.author: steven diep

reviewList.text:
We booked EMI spa the package, for a full-body massage. It was a great experience overall! My massage therapist( Mue)was very skilled-full while the massage wasn’t exactly relaxing (more of a deep, targeted treatment to fix stiff areas), it felt really good and effective.

Came with was perfect for soaking for the foot.

All in all, it was a pleasant and rejuvenating visit. I’d definitely consider returning, especially introducing for my friends from Singapore visiting to Danang. Considering to go EMI spa.
Therapist are very friendly and attractive. Who look for clean spa then should come to EMI spa. Highly recommended. I have been visited so many countries’ Spa but some spa not really nice. EMI spa is clean and nice massage. Price also reasonable price at Danang. Opposite of Han River. Nearby Dragon Bridge.
reviewList.author: August Zin

reviewList.text: My girlfriend and I had an amazing massage here today, surely the best we've ever had. The massage room was incredibly comfortable, and the air with inceresed oxygen felt so good that we feelt relaxed from the first minutes. The therapists were kind, attentive, and skillfull. We walked out feeling deeply relaxed, refreshed, and already looking forward to our next visit.
reviewList.author: Marek Olszak

reviewList.text: Walked in off the street, had a lovely foot massage. Finished with a short shoulder massage and a complimentary tea. Stop by if you are  in the area :)
reviewList.author: Tonii

reviewList.text: I had an amazing experience at Emi Spa! The massage was professional and very relaxing. The place is clean and has a great atmosphere. I highly recommend asking for Moon, she was fantastic and did an excellent job. Definitely one of the best spas in Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Fahad

reviewList.text: Very lovely massage. Was very relaxing and the massage technique was good. Facial and 45 minute massage was a great combo.
reviewList.author: Katelin Hay

reviewList.text:
My wife came here as a walk in and got her hair trimmed.

Tri Hoang Vu Hair Salon is designed to be modern, tidy, and comfortable. The staff are friendly, enthusiastic, and always attentive to the customer experience. They make you feel comfortable and well cared for when they come here, even during peak hours.

Very reasonable prices and great customer service.
reviewList.author: Cebu Food Critic

reviewList.text: I have gotten my hair washed and styled here many times by My, she always does an excellent job and is so sweet! Last time I was there I also decided to get keratherpy treatment as my hair has experienced a bit of a climate shock since coming from canada where it is cold and dry. The therapy was everything I needed and more! I came in with dry and brittle hair and left with butter soft hair! Hung and My did such a great job, i highly recommend them and the salon in general!❤️ Prices are very reasonable and i’ve been always able to just walk in and get served immediately!
reviewList.author: katarina vincent

reviewList.text: Want to have a quick haircut before leaving Vietnam. My hairstylist was Hung. He was very detailed when cutting my hair. I love it thank you !
reviewList.author: Jeess _yy

reviewList.text:
Finally treated myself to a much-needed haircut and shampoo after months of mom life chaos, and this salon exceeded every expectation. Mi, who shampooed my hair, was an absolute gem—her gentle scalp massage was pure bliss, and she made me feel so relaxed I almost fell asleep in the chair. The shampoo smelled amazing (like fresh citrus and herbs), and my hair felt incredibly clean and soft afterward.

Then Hưng took over for the cut, and wow, what a pro! He listened perfectly to my request for long layers that frame my face without losing length, and he gave expert advice on products for my fine, Asian hair that tends to frizz in Texas humidity. The cut is flawless—healthy ends, great movement, and it styles so easily. No awkward grow-out phase here!
The whole vibe was welcoming, spotless, and efficient (under 1hr total). Prices were fair, and they even threw in a quick blow-dry. I’ll be back soon and bringing my husband next time. Highly recommend for anyone wanting top-notch service and results!
reviewList.author: Nhi Dang

reviewList.text:
My mother had an outstanding experience with Master Stylist Hung Hue. From start to finish, the level of care, precision, and professionalism was evident in every step. Nothing felt rushed and every detail was thoughtfully considered, from the consultation to the final styling.

What truly stood out was the meticulous attention to technique. The cut was executed with precision, tailored perfectly to suit face shape and hair texture, and the dye work was exceptional. The transformation from long to short cut for my mother was remarkable! It didn’t just enhance her look, it completely elevated her confidence.

I also want to highlight the lady who handled the hair wash, she was excellent. Gentle yet thorough, and clearly experienced, making the entire process relaxing and comfortable.

This is easily one of the best hairstyling experiences I’ve had. Stylist Hung Hue combines technical skill with genuine dedication to the craft, and it shows in the results. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality, professionalism, and a truly transformative outcome.
reviewList.author: Larry

reviewList.text: I love this place! The staff, the service, the atmosphere, and prices for the packages are impeccable. If you get a therapist that you enjoy, ask for their name. By far my favorite is Ly (Lee) she focused on all that I asked. She worked out my lower back like I asked and fixed my ankle that was messed up from a trampoline accident. She noticed that on her own. Afterwards, they served watermelon, tea, and yogurt. That was delicious. All around 10/10
reviewList.author: Ken Pham

reviewList.text:
I had a deep tissue massage with V. She was amazing, very strong hands, just what I needed to get rid off some tension.
The place is very calm and make you feel relaxed from the time you step in. After your massage is finished, they will give you some tea, fruit and amazing home made yoghurt.
reviewList.author: Jerson Vargas

reviewList.text:
Let me start by saying I was originally going to leave 1 star. When I first came in (after lots of research and reading reviews) I decided to get a shampoo and facial. Unfortunately, my masseuse at that time was not very good. I had asked for fingertips, but got nails. I constantly had to ask for more pressure, even using translation app multiple times, but it was always lacking. She also got shampoo inside my ear drums and on my eyes.

Anyways, when I had told the front desk of my experience, I was given a 20% discount, along with a voucher for a free service of any kind (this was unexpected).

I went back the next day for a deep tissue massage, and I was very relaxed - almost fell asleep! I forgot to get her name, but she was very good. I have lots of knots and whenever it felt like things were starting to get too much, she instinctively swapped to other parts of the body without me ever having to mention anything.

reviewList.text:
I don’t usually get massages but coming from a long trip from Japan I felt I needed one. Friends didn’t have any recommendations.
So I googled whatever is near my hotel and found Nha Minh. Based on the positive reviews, I decided to come.

The rave reviews were spot on. The place was clean, relaxing and my masseuse provided friendly, effective massage. I had the one-hour (I had a meeting to go to afterwards) hot stone package. My exhausted body was restored. This was amazing great value. I loved the service so much I plan to return, as early as next week.

I have to mention Ms. Vuong, manager/owner. When I called to make a reservation, she squeezed me in at a busy time, 5pm. On my way, she followed up to make sure I found the place alright. I was 20 feet from the door and she was there waiting for me. She explained the different offerings, in very clear English. She guided me through what turned out to be the right choice for me. And as I was leaving, she saw me off at the door. Talk about deluxe customer service. This operator genuinely cares for her customers.

Lastly, a reviewer complained about temperature. It was not cold, as claimed. Not even close. Not hot either. They keep the temperature at just the right comfortable level.

Another said staff were talking all the time and it was a noisy environment. Staff talked to each other, yes, but they whispered, and said very little, like 1-2 sentences every 3 minutes or so. The place was pretty much dead quiet. All you can hear is this soft, relaxing piano lounge music. Oh and the sighs of happy customers (one reviewer said she moaned lol).

Then someone said the massage hurt? Of course it might. But you only have to tell your masseuse.  At one point I felt a bit of discomfort but I told my masseuse and immediately she adjusted her technique and pressure and it was alright after that.

This place deserves 6 stars if you ask me. I know I’ll be a regular customer.

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Wonderful, Professional Couple’s Spa Experience

During our vacation in Da Nang, my wife and I were looking for a relaxing spa day together, and Lounge Spa Danang exceeded our expectations.

The spa has created a welcoming, comfortable, and peaceful atmosphere from the moment you walk through the door. Everyone we interacted with was friendly, professional, and attentive, making us feel completely at ease.

My wife enjoyed a gel manicure and pedicure, a 60-minute foot massage, and a neck and shoulder massage. She left feeling completely refreshed and very happy with the results.

I chose their 90-minute Barbershop Combo, which included a traditional shave with facial massage, eyebrow and nose trimming, fingernail care, ear cleaning, hair wash and blow dry, plus massages for my back, legs, feet, neck, shoulders, and scalp. It was one of the most relaxing grooming experiences I’ve ever had, and the staff never made the service feel rushed.

One thing I’d especially like to mention for fellow international travelers: this is a professional wellness spa offering genuine massage and grooming services. If you’re simply looking for a relaxing, therapeutic spa experience (as we were), you can feel completely comfortable here. There were no awkward moments or uncomfortable upselling—just skilled, professional staff focused on helping us unwind.

The value was outstanding. Including tip, we paid a total of 1,540,000 VND (about US$58.56 / NZ$103.82) for everything:

* My Barbershop Combo: 460,000 VND (about US$17.49 / NZ$32.01)
* My wife’s services: 900,000 VND (about US$34.22 / NZ$60.67)

Considering the quality of the treatments and the amount of time we spent there, we thought the prices were exceptionally reasonable.

One thing to keep in mind: they currently accept cash only, so plan accordingly.

If you’re visiting Da Nang and want a legitimate, relaxing spa experience with excellent service and great value, we highly recommend Lounge Spa Danang. We wouldn’t hesitate to return on our next visit.

reviewList.text:
🌿 Tran Thao Spa – A Truly Relaxing Experience in Da Nang

During my recent trip to Da Nang, I visited Tran Thao Spa, and it turned out to be one of the most peaceful and refreshing experiences of my entire vacation. If you’re looking for a place to relax and recharge both body and mind, I can wholeheartedly recommend this spa.

⸻

✨ Location & First Impression

The spa is conveniently located near My Khe Beach — just a few minutes’ walk away. As soon as I arrived, I was warmly welcomed by the staff with a friendly smile. The entrance and waiting area were clean and beautifully decorated, and I was offered tea while waiting. It already felt like the start of a healing experience.

⸻

🌸 Atmosphere & Facilities

The moment I stepped inside, I could feel the calming ambiance — soft lighting, gentle music, and a pleasant herbal scent filled the air. The massage rooms were private, cozy, and spotless. They use natural, high-quality products, which made me feel even more comfortable and cared for.
The spa menu offers a great variety of treatments, from body massages and hot stone therapy to herbal hair washing. It’s easy to find the perfect option that suits your needs.

⸻

💆‍♀️ Service & Experience

I chose the 60-minute oil body massage + herbal hair wash combo, and it was simply amazing.
•	Before starting, the therapist asked about my preferences and focused carefully on my neck and shoulders, where I had the most tension.
•	The massage pressure was just right, and the therapist’s technique felt professional and thoughtful.
•	After the session, I was offered a warm herbal tea, which completed the relaxing experience beautifully.
•	The herbal hair wash was more than just shampooing — it included a soothing scalp massage and gentle herbal steam, leaving my head and mind refreshed.

⸻

💰 Price & Value

The price was very reasonable, especially considering the quality of the service and the atmosphere. It truly felt like great value for money, and I wouldn’t hesitate to come back on my next trip to Da Nang.

reviewList.text:
Went for a foot massage and a hair spa. Unfortunately it was not the best experience.

The staff were all friendly and polite, and the tea and snacks were nice. However, my masseuse had very long nails and I regularly felt like I was being scratched more than being massaged. At one point during my head spa I was almost tempted to just her to stop.

The place closed at 10pm so my masseuse was clearly eager to get home. She didn’t finish drying my hair (the top of my hair was still wet when we left) and we saw her leave within 2 minutes of us walking out.

Overall, I feel less than relaxed and my scalp is quite sore.

I think if you were to just get a massage, perhaps that would be better.
reviewList.author: Angie

reviewList.text:
I recently visited this head spa and had a mixed experience.

The massage was great and very relaxing, and the front desk staff were friendly and helpful.

Unfortunately, the therapist’s nails were quite sharp, which made the hair washing uncomfortable. My ear was scratched during the process, and water repeatedly entered my ear, leaving it feeling blocked afterward. During hair drying, the dryer was held in the same spot for too long, causing discomfort from the heat on my scalp.

Overall, while the massage was enjoyable, the rest of the service felt rushed and lacking attention to detail. I hope these issues can be addressed to improve the customer experience.
reviewList.author: sim yin chan

reviewList.text:
Spa Lam offers an exceptional experience, from their meticulous full pedicure with exfoliation and gel polish to their delightful treat of tea and coconut biscuits served alongside adorable cats. The staff's kindness and attention to detail ensure a relaxing session, leaving your feet as soft as a baby's. It's the perfect place for top-notch foot pampering and relaxation.
Great price and quality
reviewList.author: Na

reviewList.text:
So I've been watching those ASMA head spa videos on Tiktok and I told myself that if I ever visit Vietnam again, I would definitely book this service and try it for myself. And I did... I found Lam Spa and they offer this exact service.

And oh my god, it was one of the most spectacular things I have ever experienced in my life. It was very relaxing and my head received that much needed TLC. I chose the 15 steps hair spa treatment and it includes facial and upper body massage. It was heaven and 100% I recommend this treatment. I paid $9.82, originally priced at $10.34 because if you prebook, you get 5% discount. Not sure how long do they have this promo for though so it's best to ask them first.

They have free WiFi, and they accept cash and card payments.

reviewList.text:
I am absolutely amazed by the result! I went from a weird orange-yellow colour which was slowly growing out to this absolutely stunning balayage. The team was so concentrated when working on my hair and meticulously when trimming it in the end. You could really feel that it was important to them to get a good result, particularly because they had already mentioned in the beginning it would be hard to get a beautiful result with my short hair. But they did it!!
I chose the most expensive option, because with my hair which is already very damaged by the previous cheap colouring, I didn’t want to take any more risks. I paid around 80 dollars for the whole service which took around 3.5h. To me, the price-performance is matching.
Thank you so much! I finally feel confident with my hair again!

reviewList.text:
We were on a holiday and decided to have a haircut and straightening.

Neither of them spoke English but we were able to communicate seamlessly using google translate. They didn't feel bad that it was late and said it was their passion, and i can vouch for their dedication and passion in the way they went about their business... It was such a pleasant evening. reviewList.text:

Furthermore I enjoyed 10% discount as I booked online. In addition they accept credit cards as I did not carry cash. Also the admin for the google chat is very responsive and understand English so my concerns were addressed quickly. Dat was my hairstylist he is very patient and nice and made me feel I’m
In good hands, when I wanted the color he asked me using google translate to better advice me. The staff are all polite and pleasant, the songs are nice, the salon is very clean and bright and neat. reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I’ve had my hair cut at TungBlue Salon in Da Nang several times now, and I can genuinely say they are the best haircuts I’ve had in Da Nang.

What stands out for me is the attention to detail. They don’t rush the cut, they take the time to understand exactly what you want, and the result has been consistently excellent every time I’ve been there. The technique and precision are exceptional, and I always leave extremely happy with how my hair looks.

The salon has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and the team makes you feel welcome from the moment you arrive. You can tell there is real pride in the work they do and in making sure every customer leaves looking their best.

After trying different places, TungBlue is the salon I trust with my hair in Da Nang. I’ve been back several times because the quality is consistently that good.

If you’re visiting or living in Da Nang and looking for a genuinely talented hairdresser, I highly recommend TungBlue. ✂️💙

Excellent service, excellent skills, and consistently the best results. 5 stars from me.

I would recommend it if you are looking for activity to relax and escape from the heat in Da Nang.

reviewList.text:
We enjoyed the therapeutic treatments at Trees Spa after a long afternoon walk around Da Nang City.

Refreshed by lemon tea, we changed into comfortable spa-wear for blissful relief of body aches and tensions. The hair spa that we added on included head and neck massage, and a great-smelling shampoo.

We were served a coconut dessert before a complimentary ride back to our hotel.
reviewList.author: Cheryl Ng

reviewList.text: I came here for a facial after seeing Trees spa on TikTok. It was absolutely amazing, after a few weeks of travelling my skin was very dehydrated and dull and Thi done an amazing job. Could not recommend enough, you would pay £60+ for a treatment like this at home. I was also given tea before the treatment and some tea and mango and yoghurt after. Thank you so much!!
reviewList.author: Amy-Rose

reviewList.text: I had an excellent experience at Trees Spa Da Nang. The atmosphere was calm and relaxing, the spa was very clean, and the staff were extremely professional and friendly. The massage was amazing—skilled therapists who really know what they’re doing. I felt completely relaxed and refreshed afterward. Great service, great value, and highly recommended. I would definitely come back again. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviewList.author: JANEJIS

reviewList.text:
The massage was great, and the staff were very skilled and knowledgeable. They were professional and, like many Vietnamese people, very respectful toward us. It was excellent value for money. The room wasn’t like those in luxury hotels with lots of amenities, but you definitely get more than what you pay for. Overall, I was very happy with the service.

Suggestions for the owner:
•	Making a shower mandatory before the service could help create a more comfortable experience for the staff. Please prioritize the well-being of the young ladies who work there.
•	It would also be worth upgrading the bathroom, as the therapists do an excellent job and some guests may be a bit picky about the facilities.

reviewList.text:
A Terrible Hygiene Nightmare: My 60-Minute Vietnamese Shampoo and Shoulder Massage Experience Note: (Unfortunately, because the lighting inside was extremely dim, it was completely impossible to take any photos as evidence.)
To be honest, the moment I walked up the stairs, I already felt very uneasy—the walls around the staircase were covered in mold.
Once inside, I was asked to lie down on a bed and told to take off my upper body clothes and put on their "beauty vest." I asked where it was, and they pointed to a basket. To be frank, the lighting was extremely dim. There were only two vests in the basket, and I had no idea whether they were clean or dirty. When I asked, the staff just said, "Yes, just put it on." So I put it on and laid down.
The service itself was subpar: they only washed my hair (and since I have long hair, it wasn't a pleasant experience) and briefly touched my neck—it definitely wasn't good. Plus, every time I breathed, I could smell a heavy odor of mold. Afterward, they blow-dried and combed my hair. Honestly, I have curly hair, but they used a large brush to comb it completely straight—which is pretty ridiculous.
Of course, I was extremely unsatisfied. I felt their hygiene environment was deeply problematic. The realization hit me when I took off the vest afterward and was told to "throw it back into that same basket." It hit me like a ton of bricks: Are you kidding me? This meant the vests weren't even being washed—they were just taken off by one customer, placed right back in the basket, and handed directly to the next person. That is completely unacceptable and crossing the line!
I told my husband we must never go back there again—it was just too terrifying. The entire place was kept so dim that you couldn't see anything clearly, but the mold on the walls by the stairwell was undeniable.

reviewList.text:
Hair cut so bad I needed to go to another salon to get it fixed. And I was gonna get a perm here too. Thank God I decided to go elsewhere😩

**UPDATE since owner claimed I was not serviced there's

I came in on June 11th at around noon. I was serviced by a male employee. I was the only customer there. Please check the camera footage! Here’s proof that I did come to your salon and took a picture of your menu when I checked out. My hair cut was 200k. Looking at the menu now, my haircut was a lot cheaper than what’s showing on the menu. Did you guys give me an intern?

UPDATE 2: Let’s add GASLIGHTING to your list of characteristic as well

This picture was taken a week after I got my haircut at your salon. Your staff gave me a fake perm that’s why I didn’t see his work afterward. It wasn’t until the next day when I washed my hair that I saw how horrible it was. That’s when I had to go search for a new salon to get it fixed. The picture taken is at the new salon when I went to get it fixed because they couldn’t believe another professional salon would actually cut this hair.

You can deny it if you want but what you’re not gonna do is gaslight me into believing I was not in your shop and how much I paid your worker. Do better!

places.name: Son Tra Resort & Spa
places.summary: Warm villas with private pools in an informal beachfront resort featuring terrace dining & a spa.

reviewList.text:
I had a great stay at Son Tra Resort & Spa. The resort is peaceful, surrounded by beautiful nature, and has a lovely private beach. The room was spacious, clean, and comfortable.

The staff were friendly, helpful, and always ready to assist. The breakfast was delicious with a good variety of options. Overall, it was a relaxing and enjoyable experience. I would definitely recommend this resort and look forward to visiting again.
reviewList.author: Thùy Ngân Lương Thị

reviewList.text: Relaxed with a view and an extremely kind staff. This place is outstanding. The location and the natural setting makes the resort feel very real and full of character.  We even got to see a monkey wandering around. Unlike the bigger, flashier, and sterile resorts found in the city, Son Tra Resort has an organic feel that the villas fit into perfectly. Will definitely come back.
reviewList.author: David

reviewList.text: I had a great time at this resort. The place is very beautiful, quiet, and clean.The staff are super friendly. They always smile and help us with everything. Our room was big and very comfortable. It had a nice view of the garden.The food at the restaurant was delicious, especially the breakfast buffet. We also loved swimming in the big pool every afternoon.Everything was perfect. I highly recommend this resort to everyone!
reviewList.author: Loann trann

reviewList.text: Do yourself a favour and stay here in one of their beach front villas. Won't break the bank and breathtaking beach view from rooms. Only a short ride from the main drag, but absolutely magical and we are so grateful to have experienced this.
reviewList.author: Michelle Gardiner

reviewList.text:
We really loved our stay here. I’m giving them four stars instead of five because the reality doesn’t quite live up to the photos in the pictures. However, this place really won us over with the tranquility and truly excellent staff.
Son Tra is like a little jungle paradise. Our villa had a stunning beach view and we loved laying on the loungers by our private pool and listening to the waves. The resorts private beach is absolutely perfect, there were never more than ten people on the beach. It was so intimate and serene.
The restaurant food is pretty fine, but could do with a few more Vietnamese classics. The fresh juices were lovely and the cocktails are pleasant.
The staff really are a standout here! They’re always willing to help. They check in on you every morning to help you find experiences, but are never pushy. They also recommended us an excellent driver, who really made all our adventures in Da Nang a pleasure. If you stay here ask them to recommend Tuan to drive you around Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Kate Balazs

reviewList.text:
Very disappointing experience and strongly not recommend. We visited this massage shop since it’s just next to our hotel.

The masseur who attended to me seemed inexperienced and lacked basic technique. For a long stretch, she repeatedly applied balm and lightly stroked the same area of my calf without any proper pressure. After I used Google Translate to request more appropriate pressure and to focus on other areas, the massage became uncomfortably forceful instead, showing no understanding of proper technique or pressure points.

Overall, the experience felt unprofessional and poorly executed, as if the staff were not properly trained.

Both masseurs who served my boyfriend and I asked for tips at the end despite the poor service.
reviewList.author: Bobo Lim

reviewList.text:
I chose the relaxing body massage package with natural essential oils, and I must say that the technician's skills are great!
Moderate, rhythmic movements, pressing the right acupuncture points help the body completely relax. Especially the shoulders, neck and back - areas that often get tired from sitting at work - are carefully cared for and massaged very comfortably.
After the massage session, I felt my body feel lighter and my mind more relaxed.

reviewList.text: I had an amazing experience at Gold Spa! The atmosphere was serene, and the staff were incredibly welcoming. Highly recommend for anyone looking to unwind

reviewList.text:
I came in today for the 60-minute package at 1,500,000 dong, and unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing. From the start, I was surprised that I couldn’t choose the therapist, which is usually standard in this type of establishment.

The therapist who attended to me was rather cold and not very welcoming. The shower was rushed and lacked any sensuality, and the massage showed a clear lack of skill — just a few quick strokes on my back, arms, and neck for barely ten minutes. It didn’t feel like a proper moment of relaxation at all.

As for the ending, given her lack of technique and motivation, it was impossible for me to finish. Feeling uncomfortable, I chose to cut the session short and leave.

I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone looking for a quality experience.
reviewList.author: El Gigante

reviewList.text: SCAMMERS!! I Got scammed here today. The reviews are fake, stay away especially if you’re a westerner. They brought me a masseuse who instantly complained that I’m “too big” and she will not offer anything apart from “hand relief”. I asked for a change of waiters and they brought me another one with a worse attitude than the former. She also said no way she would do anything other than “hand relief”, using the excuse that I’m too big and a “westerner”. This was clearly an excuse and not reality, I would’ve appreciated the compliment if it was real. I settled for whatever she said she would offer and 5 minutes into the session she started barking at me in Vietnamese in a very loud voice for absolutely no reason. I was genuinely shocked and speechless, I had no idea what went wrong as I didn’t even move or open my mouth; the girl was clearly frustrated and had bruises on her chest; her eyes also looked swollen. I became very uncomfortable, ended the session instantly, and walked out. I got a bad sense of trafficking happening at this place, didn’t even bother to ask for my money back because I realized after the first masseuse interaction that I had just gotten scammed. The place is sketchy and I felt unsafe; you have been warned.
